column1: # Shared fork-layer rename table: NeoForge 1.21.3 -> 1.21.4 (Minecraft 1.21.4; NeoForge 21.4). Applied AFTER the
# fork's own rows and on top of the 1.21.3 table (a 1.21.4 target inherits 1.21.3). Measured against
# neoforge-21.4.158-sources.jar on the first layer-fork port. CATALOG §M / minor-version-deltas L8+.
#!exhaustive  shared table: most rows are for API this mod does not use
# ---- client reload listeners: a named graph in 1.21.4
# ---- NeoForge 21.4: ClientLevel.partEntities (id -> part map) is gone; dragonParts() is the list of all parts
# ---- TextureManager.register(String prefix, texture) -> named registration (the first argument is a string)
# ---- FML 6 (NeoForge 21.4) early display: SimpleBufferBuilder takes a name for its buffer
# ---- LevelRenderer.renderLevel lost its LightTexture argument (1.21.4); this row runs before the 1.21.3 one, on the
# 1.21.1 text, so it writes the full 1.21.4 descriptor itself
# ---- mixin targets: ScreenEffectRenderer.renderScreenEffect(Minecraft, PoseStack) gained a MultiBufferSource
# (measured on neoforge-21.4.158); an @Inject handler needs the extra parameter before its CallbackInfo
# ---- RenderType.entityTranslucentCull is gone (1.21.2) and RenderType.entityTranslucent sets NO_CULL, so mapping one to
# the other draws the model double-sided (compile-clean, gates green). NeoForgeRenderTypes.getItemLayeredTranslucent is
# the 1.21.1 state: entity-translucent shader, default CULL, translucent, lightmap, overlay, sorted -- same signature on
# 1.21.5 and 1.21.8 (NeoForgeRenderPipelines.ENTITY_TRANSLUCENT_CULL). Rows do not reach overlays. CATALOG M73.
